'''Skalus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] diplomat who served as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] official [[consulate|representative]] as [[Consul-General]] to the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Asation]].<ref name="The Gree Enclave" />

==Biography==
Skalus was in charge of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[consulate]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Asation]] to the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He hated his position, and kept a low profile. Skalus hoped that by ignoring the sector [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] office's pleas to gather uncollected tax revenues, he would get demoted and reassigned.<ref name="The Gree Enclave" />
